title: Run ng update to 22 and apply its migrations
goal: Every @angular/* package and angular-eslint is on 22
acceptance: `npx ng update @angular/core@22 @angular/cli@22` and `angular-eslint@22` run, their migrations committed apart from manual fixes
TypeScript and the other dependencies moved to the versions F-007-T01 found
check:fast, npm test, core:test and npm run build pass locally
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A dependency with no Angular 22 support, or a material effort increase, goes to the owner before the upgrade continues

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: a small app (eight components, one route); the migrations do most of it. Not a measurement.
